'''M4-3B Security Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These droids patrolled area near the [[Darth Revan's complex]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
M4-3B Security Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />
